prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: anatomical construction game transparent sprite atlas. Style reference: luminous cyan fine contours, translucent coral and violet organs, restrained gold accents. Create 2048x2048 transparent image with THREE columns by THREE rows of isolated images, each within its own 682x682 cell, 45px transparent margin. Do not add typography, labels, panels, borders, grid, shadows, scene, symbols or badges.
Top left: complete frontal urinary organs at organ scale, two burgundy kidney cutaways with red and blue blood vessel stubs, both pale coral ureters descend continuously into muscular pink bladder with urethral outlet. No spine. 440px wide and 570 tall.
Top middle: magnified kidney filtering unit, glomerulus red capillary ball enclosed in violet Bowman's cup, blood inlet and outlet continue separately; cup drains rightward into proximal tubule. Red cells remain in capillaries; transparent cyan water with small dissolved molecules present in cup. Include small kidney locator lower left joined with fine cyan leader. 560px wide.
Top right: matching magnified recovery tubule at same anatomical magnification as top middle: looping coral epithelial tube carries pale amber fluid, red and blue capillary beside it. Several small cyan water molecules and amber nutrient molecules between tubule and vessel showing reabsorption. Small matching kidney locator lower left. 560px wide.
Middle left: same kidney filter cup and beginning of tubule, selected filtered pale cyan fluid volume extends through the lumen, many tiny water/salt/glucose/waste particles; blood with red cells stays in its separate adjacent vessel. 540px wide.
Middle middle: same tubule outlet with smaller amber urine fluid volume within actual tubular lumen, fewer water particles and remaining salts/wastes. No red cells in urine. 540px wide.
Middle right: same tubule outlet with still smaller deeper amber concentrated urine volume, fewer water particles with similarly many salts and waste particles; adjacent capillary receives recovered cyan water. 540px wide.
Bottom left: frontal cutaway of an intestinal absorbing wall, intact row of tall epithelial cells across width500, a capillary below filled with red cells, gut lumen is above, pale cyan water volume crossing the intact cellular lining toward blood, no holes through lining. Thin tissue support below, actual anatomical receiver.
Bottom middle: shallow translucent spatial volume of water, 220x110, with a population of tiny cyan water molecules across it, NOT a teardrop or vessel or glass.
Bottom right: same isolated kidney pair cutaway at smaller final body-model scale, no ureters/bladder, frontal view. Kidneys separated width310 with small blood vessel stubs clearly distinct from their drainage outlets.
All elements remain recognizably physical anatomy and fluid volumes. Transparent background.
